notes: The manual is picture-only and low resolution; the exact stud positions and layer order of the body (steps 1-4), tail (step 7) and neck are best-effort inferences, constrained by the official parts list (39 pieces, every piece used once).

The two legs (steps 5 and 6) differ slightly in the pictures but are modelled as an identical repeat (foot plate, two tan 1x2 bricks, two reddish-brown 1x1 bricks, inverted slope on top); the second leg is attached at a different position under the body plate.
The inverted slope 3660 has top studs in reality, but the catalogue lists only anti-studs, so its connection to the body plate uses a null port on the slope.
Neck/head hinge chain (tan 2-finger / reddish-brown 1-finger hinge plates) is inferred from the final picture; hinge pairs are joined by hinge edges and stacked with studs.

The tan curved brick 41855 is placed at the left end of the body (step 4) and the 45-degree slope 3039 forms the head snout; teeth plates are on the head and the reddish-brown 1x2 plate carries the two cone ears.
